item.title: Movies playing on 2026-10-08
item.description:
Acharya [Nepali, subtitled]

This is the story of Acharya, an ex-Army man who takes on a contract to rescue a young woman stranded in Mumbai and bring her safely back to Nepal. What begins as a straightforward rescue mission soon turns into a dangerous and unexpected journey. As Acharya travels with the young woman from Mumbai to Nepal, new twists, secrets, and turns begin to unfold, forcing him to confront challenges far beyond what he had anticipated.

Angel and the Badman

When feared outlaw Quirt Evans staggers onto a rancher's land with a bullet in his back, he expects a quick death, not mercy. But Penny, the rancher's daughter, offers him a chance at something he’s never had: a life beyond violence. However, the past doesn’t forgive. With the marshal closing in and an outlaw gang ready to burn the ranch to the ground, Quirt must decide what kind of man he’ll be when the world demands blood.

Avengers Endgame: Encore

PLEASE NOTE: Select Avengers Endgame: Encore bonus content is available exclusively on CINÉXL and 4D shows. The epic conclusion to the Infinity Saga returns to theaters as Avengers Endgame: Encore on September 25, 2026. After devastating events wiped out half the world’s population, the remaining heroes struggle to move forward. Ultimately, they must come together to restore order and harmony in the universe and bring their loved ones back in a dramatic showdown against Thanos.

Beware Boiúna

A team of doctors embark on a local mission in the Amazon rainforest, but it soon becomes clear that not everybody - or everything - is happy to see them. Their sudden appearance draws the attention of an animal predator, the "Boiúna".

Buddy The Sing-Along Version

Remember BUDDY — the bright orange unicorn and star of that classic childrens' television show who brought joy and life lessons into your living room? Inside the colorful world of "It's Buddy!", a group of children spend their days singing, dancing, and helping Buddy spread happiness. But when one child refuses to play along, Buddy is not pleased and cracks begin to appear in this seemingly perfect world. Now in a SING-ALONG!

Coyote vs. ACME

After decades of being blown to bits by bombs, demolished by dynamite, mangled by magnets, battered by boulders, trampled by trains, tricked by tunnels, sprung by springs, steamrolled by steamrollers, maligned by misfires, bedeviled by bungees, rattled by rockets, backstabbed by bat suits, rocked by rocket skates, upended by unicycles, quaked by quake pills, rubberized by rogue bands, and hurled headlong off every cliff in the Southwest, Wile E. Coyote (Genius) finally fights back. Teaming up with billboard accident lawyer Kevin Avery (Will Forte), he takes on slick corporate counsel Buddy Crane (John Cena) and ACME, Inc., the profit-obsessed conglomerate behind every one of the Coyote’s chaotic catastrophes.

Daniel and the Fiery Furnace

From The Kooman Brothers and the Executive Producer of I Can Only Imagine, DANIEL AND THE FIERY FURNACE is a declaration of faith, resilience, and the power of standing firm when everything is on the line. A live-action biblical drama about courage, unshakable faith, and defiance in the face of impossible odds. DANIEL: THE FIERY FURNACE brings the origin story of the Prophet Daniel to life, based on one of the most beloved and awe-inspiring moments in Scripture — the story of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego. Three men. One decree. A blazing furnace. And a defiance that would ignite a miracle seen around the world.

Digger

The most powerful man in the world embarks on a frantic mission to prove he is humanity's saviour before the disaster he’s unleashed destroys everything.

Forgotten Island

While celebrating their last night together, Jo and Raissa stumble upon a mysterious portal that transports them to the fantastical island of Nakali, packed with magical and mythological creatures they grew up hearing stories about from their Filipino families. Some of these figures will become friends, some foes. Joined by well-meaning-but- hapless weredog Raww (Dave Franco) and a small-but-mighty pack of pals, Jo and Raissa must face The Dreaded Manananggal (Tony winning icon Lea Salonga), the most feared creature on the island. When they discover that the memories of their entire friendship are the price for returning home, Jo and Raissa will race to find a way to leave the island before they forget each other forever.

Heart of the Beast

After a harrowing plane crash, Special Forces officer James Belmont (Brad Pitt) and his combat dog, Odin, find themselves stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness. Together, they are forced into a brutal fight for survival against the elements. From acclaimed filmmaker David Ayer, Heart of the Beast is an intense adventure thriller that explores the unbreakable bond between a man and his best friend as they face their greatest battle yet.

Insidious: Out of the Further

In Insidious: Out of the Further, Amelia Eve stars as Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in who discovers she can travel into The Further, the purgatorial realm of lost souls at the heart of the Insidious universe. When something evil comes after her, Gemma discovers an ability that changes everything: she doesn’t just enter The Further, she can bring what lives there back to the real world. Once the demons realize her power, our world becomes their playground.

Jhingedaau 2 [Nepali, subtitled]

Jhingedaaw-2 continues the beloved story with Khanalni’s two sons embarking on a heartfelt journey to find their missing mother. Their search takes them through the villages, towns, and changing landscapes of a bygone Nepal, where every encounter reveals the richness of the country’s culture, traditions, and way of life. Driven by sibling rivalry, comic misunderstandings, and unwavering determination, the brothers navigate unexpected challenges that test their bond and resilience. Blending nostalgia, humor, and emotion, Jhingedaaw-2 celebrates the enduring strength of family while offering audiences a warm and captivating glimpse into the Nepal of generations past.

Journey

After Roberto is deported to Mexico, he’s forced into a desperate journey back to the United States before his first child is born. With no legal path home, he must navigate an unforgiving landscape where every mile brings new dangers, unexpected allies, and impossible choices. As the distance between him and his family grows, Robert risks everything to make it back home.

Other Mommy - Fan Event Screenings

Celebrate BlumFest at the Fan Event Screening of OTHER MOMMY featuring bonus on-screen content before the film. Bela, an 8-year-old girl living in a home with marital problems, confronts a sinister entity that comes out of her closet. The presence, whom she calls "Other Mommy," becomes increasingly threatening to her and her family.

Other Mommy

Bela, an 8-year-old girl living in a home with marital problems, confronts a sinister entity that comes out of her closet. The presence, whom she calls "Other Mommy," becomes increasingly threatening to her and her family.

Practical Magic 2

Starring Sandra Bullock and Nicole Kidman, Practical Magic 2 returns to a world steeped in moonlit mischief and powerful ancestral magic, as the Owens sisters must confront the dark curse that threatens to unravel their family once and for all in a must-see cinematic event of fun, magic and mayhem.

Resident Evil

From the mind of visionary filmmaker Zach Cregger (Weapons, Barbarian) comes a thrilling — and terrifying — reinvention of the Resident Evil franchise. In an all-new story, Resident Evil follows Bryan (Austin Abrams), a medical courier who unwittingly finds himself in an action-packed, non-stop race for survival as one fateful, horrifying night collapses around him in chaos.

Resident evil: Noche cero [doblado en Español]

De la mente del visionario cineasta Zach Cregger (Weapons, Barbarian) llega una emocionante — y aterradora — reinvención de la franquicia Resident Evil. En una historia completamente nueva, Resident Evil sigue a Bryan (Austin Abrams), un mensajero médico que, sin saberlo, se ve envuelto en una carrera por la supervivencia llena de acción y sin tregua cuando una noche fatídica y espantosa se convierte en un caos a su alrededor.

Rolling Loud: The Movie

A father makes a bad parenting choice by taking his young son to a wild hip-hop festival, leading to chaos as they navigate crowds, security, and family dynamics with eccentric companions.

SB19 Wakas at Simula in Cinemas

From the Philippines to the world, SB19's historic Wakas at Simula: The Trilogy Concert Finale comes to cinemas worldwide. Captured before a record breaking crowd of nearly 100,000 fans, the film showcases the group's biggest hits, spectacular production, and world class performances that have made SB19 one of Asia's most influential acts. Experience the power of GENTO, What?, and DAM as the Philippines' biggest pop phenomenon takes over the big screen in an unforgettable celebration of music, fandom, and legacy. More than a concert film, it is the story of a movement—one built by five artists, millions of fans, and a dream that helped redefine Filipino music for a new generation.

Spider-Man: Brand New Day

It's a BRAND NEW DAY for Peter Parker. Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn’t remember him -- and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him -- sparks a change in Peter he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see. The world may have forgotten Peter Parker, but he hasn’t forgotten them.

The Influencer Project

In THE INFLUENCER PROJECT, real-life content creator Chiara King travels to Copenhagen with a documentary crew promising an unfiltered look behind the glamorous business of online fame. But as the cameras and her devoted fans follow her every move, someone else is watching too. When an obsessive stalker begins closing in, the documentary becomes something far more terrifying, blurring the line between content and evidence, follower and predator, fact and fiction. From the visionary creators of THE BLAIR WITCH PROJECT comes a chilling descent into a new generation of fear, influenced by actual events.

The Social Reckoning

Inspired by true events and the whistleblower who started the social media reckoning we’re seeing play out today, this Aaron Sorkin original screenplay is a companion piece to the hit film The Social Network and a true David and Goliath story. Frances Haugen (Madison), a young Facebook engineer, enlists the help of Jeff Horwitz (White), a Wall Street Journal reporter, to go on a dangerous journey that ends up blowing the whistle on the social network’s most guarded secrets.

Verity

Adapted from Colleen Hoover's best-selling novel, this seductive, psychological thriller follows renowned author Verity Crawford (Anne Hathaway) and Lowen Ashleigh (Dakota Johnson), a struggling writer who relocates to the remote Crawford estate to ghostwrite for Verity. After Lowen uncovers what appears to be Verity's chilling autobiographical notes, she wrestles with the disturbing and twisted confessions about Verity’s husband Jeremy (Josh Hartnett), and finds it hard to separate fiction from reality, manipulation from attraction, and opportunity from obsession.
